nodes.name: MQMD amorphous generation
nodes.procedure: Three-stage procedure: 1) Distribute N atoms randomly in cubic box (density = 15% volumetric expansion of stable phase volume/atom or average for phase mixtures). 2) Brief relaxation with soft-sphere potential (JAX-MD, quadratic repulsion, max 30 steps or until shortest interatomic distance >90% summed ionic radii). 3) Three-step GNN MD protocol: equilibrate melt at T_high (1,500 steps), quench to T_low (2,500 steps), equilibrate at T_low (1,500 steps). NVT ensemble, Nose-Hoover thermostat, 2 fs timestep. Optional final GD relaxation. T_high/T_low per Extended Data Table 1 (e.g., MgF2: 900K/150K; YbFeO3: 2500K/300K).

nodes.name: Crystallization prediction
nodes.procedure: Exhaustively create all orthorhombic parallelepipeds (subcells) from amorphous structure with edges parallel to unit vectors of parent cubic box on n_grid × n_grid × n_grid point net (default n_grid=10). Filter subcells using maximum atom counts or stoichiometry constraints. Optimize all geometric degrees of freedom (atomic positions, cell size/shape) using NequIP-based equivariant GNN potential with fire algorithm for at least 150 steps. Lowest-energy structures at each composition are predicted crystallization products.
